caption: Javelin with a damaged tip is thrown; it wobbles in flight and lands off-target.
first_prompt: A single realistic photograph of the initial scene immediately BEFORE the following action begins: Javelin with a damaged tip is thrown; it wobbles in flight and lands off-target. Show the participants and objects in their starting positions, with enough room for the action. Show one moment only, not a montage, not the completed outcome. No text or diagrams.

clauses.text: The javelin must be visibly damaged at the tip before being thrown.
The javelin must exhibit wobbling motion during its flight.
The javelin must land in a location that is not the intended target area.
The javelin's trajectory must be visibly altered due to the damage, resulting in an off-target landing.
